assessment: The Hippo signaling pathway has emerged as a key signaling pathway in cancer and many other diseases, but there is a lack of high-quality chemical tools that would enable functional studies. Fan et al. disclose the development of covalent TEAD inhibitors and report on the therapeutic potential of this class of agents in the treatment of TEAD-YAP-driven cancers. The authors' claims and conclusions are well supported by the data. The optimized derivative represents a clear improvement from previously reported compounds and provides a high-quality probe for future studies.
